title: Rules and regulations.
bodyText: The department of land and natural resources shall make rules and regulations pursuant to chapter 91, as it deems necessary to carry out the purpose of this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§520-8]  Rules and regulations.  The department of land and natural resources shall make rules and regulations pursuant to chapter 91, as it deems necessary to carry out the purpose of this chapter. [L 1969, c 186, §8]
